contract.note: In context (the cake without the recipe), the ordinary reading is that no reproducible recipe is disclosed. The contract keeps a stricter literal reading as well, but that reading still needs 'substantive' published methods to contradict the claim. Interpretation matters.

reviews.rationale: Listing generic curation categories does not meet either reading's bar for revealing preprocessing. No representative dated inventory in the packet confirms or refutes that raw corpora and exact training recipes were missing. Unresolved.
